aiResearchSummary.text: GoBubble is researching content generation and assessment and content moderation using trained machine learning models. In content generation and assessment, a computer implemented method receives a content item and predicts the emotion the content item will evoke in a recipient, enabling emotion aware analysis. In content moderation, a machine learning moderation component analyzes media posts using multiple models and combines their outputs, focusing on emotion prediction and automated moderation.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,433,716 to $10,239,175, a 2.98x increase.
